scope: Read-only reinspection of original brief/scorer for disallowance of the fixed .05 market sleeve, gross-five control, and conclusion wording. No policy execution.
conclusion: No original rule disallows the fixed +.05 equal-weight stock sleeve or self-imposed gross-five limit; both remain subject to the full future book beta, causality, solvency and runtime conditions.
findings: The brief permits long, short, leverage and concentration, with no additional portfolio constraint beyond the stated beta and solvency requirements. Gross five and per-stock caps are our choices, not assignment mandates.

The beta condition concerns regression of the full future daily net return on the equal-weight market over the entire future run. Current sample beta is evidence, not a guarantee of the future condition; the sleeve does not have its own separate beta allowance.

The brief explicitly discourages a strategy that is mostly long the market. Report the fixed market allocation honestly and distinguish it from unchanged stock-selection alpha; the numeric beta condition remains binding.

Stateful policies, helper files and arbitrary first-axis-days forecast signals are permitted. Whole-sample parameter selection is expressly allowed, but every forecast row/position remains restricted to prior-day information.
Runtime is average rebalance below100ms on one core; a single call above100ms is not by itself a violation. Forecasting may take about one hour per century.

The submission must be portable strategy.py plus required helper files and a short note describing beliefs, construction, AI/human attribution and expected long-run failure modes. Research loaders or absolute evidence paths are not a production handoff.
The original scorer uses actual stock-trade costs, free opening, gross-return position drift, and a final charged target that is not earned. No extra costless market instrument exists.
wording_cautions: All current historical segment scores are exposed development; future modified-data checks demonstrate tested causal invariance, not future profitability.
The century replay is an operational stress on repeated data and cannot be reported as new out-of-sample alpha evidence.
Keep the inherited E2 post-solve proportional gross-scaling qualification when describing optimizer certificates.
